title: Ngoni language (Tanzania)
description: Bantu language spoken in southwestern Tanzania
extract: Ngoni is a Bantu language spoken in the Songea region of Tanzania. It is not an Nguni language, but only retains the name: It started as the Pangwa dialect of Nguni captives; over generations the original Nguni language was lost.
